subject: Bridge window proposal + last-minute APAC rescue
messages:
From: Alex Greene <alex.greene@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mari Gonzalez <mari.gonzalez@fintech.io>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700 (PDT)
Subject: Request: 90-min technical deep dive (architects + SEs)

Hi Marissa / Vivek,

Thanks for the quick responses on the POC. Our platform team (myself + Mari CC'd) would like a 90-minute technical deep dive focused on productionizing inference: model variants, KV cache warmup, and multi-region routing. We're spread across three zones so trying to find the best overlap.

A few constraints from our side:
- My team (PST): generally good 08:00–11:30 and 13:00–16:00 PT.
- EU architects (CET): 09:00–12:00 and 16:00–19:00 CET.
- APAC (JST): 09:30–12:30 JST is best for our Tokyo engineers.

Note: US daylight saving just shifted on 14 Mar, so our PST times are now PDT — apologies if that creates confusion. Could you propose 3 candidate windows that cover at least 60–90 minutes of real overlap, or a primary + fallback plan?

We can host the call. Also prefer to have a 15-min pre-call for SEs to warm up cache if possible.

Thanks,
Alex Greene
Senior Platform Architect
Acme Cloud

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: 90-min technical deep dive (architects + SEs)

Alex — thanks for the detail, and good call flagging DST. I sketched a pragmatic approach and attached an overlap grid (overlap_grid_20270315.xlsx) with conversions. High level:

Primary (90 min):
- Option A — Tue 23 Mar: 16:00–17:30 CET / 07:00–08:30 PDT / 00:00–01:30 JST (this hits EU morning + US early, APAC late-night; only ~60–75% overlap for APAC)

Secondary (60–75 min, better APAC):
- Option B — Wed 24 Mar: 00:00–01:30 CET / 15:00–16:30 PDT / 07:00–08:30 JST (this gives a better 75–90 min slice for APAC and US afternoon)

Fallback (shorter, split sessions):
- Option C — Two-part: 45-min focused tech deep-dive for EU/US + 30-min APAC follow-up the next morning (we can record).

Operational asks from our side:
- Can your team provide the model name(s) you want us to load and a sample prompt set?
- Confirm whether you want us to hold a 15-min SE pre-call to warm KV cache (we can do 15 min prior).

I've attached a calendar stub (se_availability.ics) and the overlap grid for exact conversions. If none of these work, propose 3 slots from your side and we'll pick the closest.

If helpful, Vivek, Dylan — want to flag anything technical or an ideal time we should avoid?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Quick note from the SE side — thanks Marissa. For a productive deep dive I want to lock these in advance:
- Model(s) + weights path or model repo tag so we can pre-pull.
- Typical sequence length and a representative prompt batch (10–20 prompts).
- If you're pushing large batches, please indicate expected concurrency.

Operationally we'll do the 15-min KV warmup before the session. If we land on Option B (the 15:00–16:30 PDT / 07:00–08:30 JST slot) that works best for my team — gives us daylight overlap to coordinate follow-ups.

Also a heads-up: we'll route requests through the EU region for compliance reasons during the session unless you explicitly want US routing for performance testing.

—Dylan
